suites.name: ForkStockRoutes
suites.note: all five V1 routes (AAPL, AMD, AMZN, COIN, CRCL) probed against live pools

finding.cause: Booster.sol:395 reverts BadFeed() when block.timestamp - feed.updatedAt > stockFeedStaleAfter (1 day). The run forked live HEAD on Sunday 2026-08-16; the AAPL equity feed (0x6B22A786bAa607d76728168703a39Ea9C99f2cD0) last updated Friday 2026-08-14 (updatedAt=1786717307), ~2.1 days before the fork timestamp (1786898942), so the equity feed was legitimately stale.
finding.evidence: On-chain latestRoundData().updatedAt read at HEAD = 1786717307; HEAD block.timestamp = 1786898942; delta 181635s > 86400s staleAfter.
finding.conclusion: The two failures are a market-calendar artifact of forking at a weekend HEAD, not a code defect. The four feed-independent suites (including all five live stock routes) pass. ForkFullSystem and ForkScaleClaims set a live equity feed and require it fresh.
finding.remaining: Reproduce a clean 6/6 by forking a US-market-hours weekday block where the equity feeds are within their staleness window. The public RPC prunes historical state (metadata not found beyond ~1.26M blocks back), so this final release run needs an archive RPC or must run live during market hours.
